title: グラフィック・コミュニケーション
subtitle: Graphic Communication
educationalGoal:
Students learn sketch skills as communication tools and visualizing of ideas.
Creators think about products physical objects and dynamic phenomena. In this class, students learn logical freehand drawing skills to represent these objects freely.  In the second half, they will use their acquired skills to conduct emotional expression and communication training and acquire practical skills.
advice:
1. To understand drawing
    Creators think about physical objects and dynamic phenomena and reaction. Drawing methods of them are different. Therefore, students understand each of methods.

2. To acquire drawing skills
   Students learn the logical skills to draw physical objects and dynamic phenomena briefly.

3. Training of using drawing skills
   Students train drawing skills to express and communicate their own ideas each other.

4. Review of student's works
   All students present their own works and get reviews from teachers.
books:
Textbook: Idea drawing as a tool for communication [Kyoritsu-pub.]
Reference book: IDEA DRAWING HOW TO DRAW [Tanaka & Shobundo Graphic Art Co., Ltd.]

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the basic skills to draw forms of physical objects precisely.
Be able to draw objects from various viewpoints.
Be able to draw pictures transmitting same meaning to everyone.
Be able to draw own ideas precisely.
be able to understand how important drawing is as a means of communication.

lessons.content: Freehand basic skills for visualizing of ideas

Drawing skills for representing human body
and dynamic phenomena

Apparent shapes that change
with various viewpoints

Figures that do not change
with different viewpoints
Memorize apparent shapes of a cube
Drawing solid shapes by using a cube
How to define positions and shapes in drawing

Learning creator's idea expressions and
communication skills.
